decisions.decision: Station S3 (input order) folds into S2; the option set encodes prefix/postfix order. Marks series goes from 5 stations to 4.
Prominence is derived from attestation + productivity spread only. No frequency signal; spec 050-text-sample-prefill could supply one and is deliberately not used.

Work split in two: this spec is the question; regional-incumbent prefill (region -> likely-used keyboards -> diacritic-mechanism facet -> proposal) is a follow-up spec and explicitly out of scope here.

Platform-specific option sets reduce to ONE answer: (treatment, order) + promoted combos. Touch 'layer-then-single-key' is a placement variant of single-key; desktop 'deadkey-then-letter' is an order variant of mark-key. Deadkey-on-touch becomes unrepresentable rather than warned. THIS IS THE ONE JUDGEMENT MADE ON THE OWNER'S BEHALF - confirm at plan review.

Issue #1433 ABSORBED into this spec as User Story 4 (P4), reversing the earlier decision to defer it. Rationale: the strategy audit found that US1 triples the S2 answer surface while leaving it disconnected from strategy selection, which widens the contradiction rather than inheriting it. Adds FR-024..FR-027, SC-011, SC-012, two edge cases, and amendments to the strategy decision tree and its self-consistency table. #1433 is now CLOSED by this feature, not refs.

Team-boundary constraint WAIVED by the product owner for this feature: engine and content sides are being authored together. Constitution Article VI is unchanged and still applies to other features; the plan's Constitution Check must RECORD THE WAIVER rather than assert single-team compliance.

Promote utilities/facet-index/spare-key-budget-classifier.ts measurement to packages/contracts/src/keyBudget.ts as the single authoritative key-budget determination; axis A7 becomes a total, bijective projection of its three bands; base-layouts.json relocates to packages/contracts/data/.
decisions.why: It is the only one of the three competing determinations that actually computes anything - the numeric spareKeys parameter and axis A7 both have NO producer anywhere outside tests. Contracts (not engine) is the home because utilities/facet-index must keep reading it and a utility may not be depended upon by a package. Bijective banding keeps rule 10s fully-booked predicate firing on exactly todays input set, so the three RAlt-only rows in the 7.5 table are unmoved.
decisions.rejected: Making A7 canonical (would canonicalise an absence, and its display-string values are documented as unsafe map keys); making the numeric spareKeys canonical (a raw count cannot express ralt-only, which is about WHICH plane has room); injecting the key set and leaving the table tool-local (makes the function single but the data still tool-local, so the divergence returns).

decisions.decision: FR-016 is satisfied by DEFINING A7 as a projection, not by newly seeding A7 into the live session.axes.
decisions.why: A7 has no live producer, so seeding it would be a first-time activation rather than a preservation: MechanismGallerys fullAxes completeness check would start passing (turning on axis-based pattern ranking for the first time) and rule 10 would start appending S-08 to real selections. Both are far outside this features scope. SC-008 still holds, and holds more strongly - one measurement, no live A7 report to disagree with anything.
decisions.rejected: Seeding A7 live in this feature (a strategy-selection and gallery-ranking change wearing a key-budget costume); skipping the projection entirely (leaves FR-016 unmet and SC-008 unverifiable).

decisions.decision: CONFIRMED the owner-flagged platform-collapse judgement: one (treatment, order) answer plus promotions covers both platforms; the option set is NOT platform-forked; deadkey-on-touch is unrepresentable rather than warned.
decisions.why: The codebase settles it. packages/studio/src/steps/advance.ts routes EVERY project through both the mechanisms and touch spine steps, so there is no touch-only target for a forked option set to key on. And the unrepresentable claim is already true: scaffoldTouchLayout.ts resolves recognized deadkey patterns into long-press sk[] subkey menus, so no answer the author can give produces a deadkey on touch. FR-014s second clause is therefore the load-bearing half and is pinned with a derivation test.
decisions.rejected: Adding a target-platform question so the option set can fork (adds a screen to a series whose FR-018 forbids gaining one, to serve a distinction the product does not make); warning on deadkey-on-touch (a warning about a state the derivation cannot produce).

decisions.decision: US4 derives A4/A3a FROM the recorded treatment via SurveyPhaseResult.computedAxes; the FR-024 disagreement check runs on the SELECTED STRATEGY after selectStrategy, not on the raw axis.
decisions.why: computedAxes already exists as an additive optional field merged by mergePhaseResults into session.axes - so US4 needs NO contract change, only a producer; its absence IS issue #1433. defaultFillAxes structurally never overwrites an axis already present, so the recorded answer wins over the prior for free. Checking the selection rather than the axis honours the specs own edge case: a base whose behaviour the author knowingly overrode is a legitimate override, not a disagreement.
decisions.rejected: Deriving treatment FROM A4 (A4 is coarser - four values - and cannot express per-mark treatment or promotions, so the derivation would lose information); detect-and-surface only, deriving nothing (FR-027 requires a treatment change to be reflected in subsequent selection).

decisions.decision: The 7.5 EuroLatin multi-family gap is RESTATED AS OPEN with its reason unchanged, not closed. PlacementWorklists shape is left unchanged (ownLetterUnits keeps its now-misleading name); only verifyWorklistCoverages classified-twice assertion is deleted.
decisions.why: The EuroLatin rows reason is that MML-as-target is out of scope for v1; nothing in this feature changes MML scope, so closing it would need evidence this feature does not produce. Restating unchanged is what FR-026/US4-AC4 permit and what is honest. Leaving the worklist shape alone keeps the spec assumption that drafts load without migration (FR-021/SC-010) and avoids touching the reducer, carves needed-set derivation, and the mechanism gallery for no behavioural gain.
decisions.rejected: Renaming ownLetterUnits to keyedUnits for honesty - breaks the worklist-shape-unchanged assumption and touches every downstream consumer; worth a separate maint(contracts) change.

decisions.decision: MarkTreatmentPrefill and BaseMarkMechanism are declared in treatment.ts (the vocabulary module), not in treatment-prefill.ts (the computing module), and re-exported from the latter.
decisions.why: treatmentFor resolves THROUGH the prefill, so the vocabulary module needs its type; declaring it in the computing module produced a real depcruise no-circular violation (treatment-prefill -> promotion -> treatment -> treatment-prefill). The contract doc already documents the prefill as part of the answer contract, so this placement matches it.
decisions.rejected: Suppressing the depcruise rule for a type-only cycle, or inlining a structural duplicate of the prefill shape in treatment.ts.

decisions.decision: KeyBudget carries a fourth field, planes: { shiftBound, altgrBound, stockKeys }, beyond the three the contract doc pins.
decisions.why: The facet classifier reports the total bound-key count as its evidenceSize. Without machine-readable plane counts the only options were re-deriving the plane analysis inside the tool - the exact duplication FR-016 exists to remove - or regex-parsing the counts back out of the notes prose, which makes a prose string load-bearing.
decisions.rejected: Parsing the counts out of KeyBudget.notes (implemented first, then removed as fragile); dropping evidenceSize, which would have moved a shipped facet-index value.

decisions.decision: The FR-024 disagreement check runs after selectStrategy, on the selection, and fires only when every mark is composed while the selected primary is a compose-as-you-type strategy.
decisions.why: Research D6 and the spec edge case: a base whose mechanism the author knowingly overrode is a legitimate override, not a disagreement. Only a contradiction with the SELECTED strategy counts. The check is also not redundant with the A4 derivation - rule 5 fires on A3/A1 alone, so a composing primary can still be selected when the derived A4 is none.
decisions.rejected: Checking the raw axis vector, which would fire on every deliberate override of a base-derived signal.

decisions.decision: @keyboard-studio/contracts bumped 0.16.0 -> 0.17.0 alongside the engine 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 that tasks.md specified.
decisions.why: US3 adds a new locked surface to contracts (keyBudget.ts, its zod mirrors and Art. I drift guards, and the relocated pinned table). The package bumps its 0ver minor for every locked-surface change (0.11.0 IRPath, 0.12.0 TouchKeyIR.provenance, 0.13.0 touch schemas); leaving it unbumped would break that convention silently.
decisions.rejected: Leaving contracts at 0.16.0 because tasks.md did not name a contracts bump.

decisions.decision: promotableCharacters does not require a promoted character to have a single-codepoint precomposed form.
decisions.why: The data model defines a promotion as a reachable base+mark pair placed on a dedicated key; a key can emit a two-codepoint sequence just as well as one. Filtering to precomposed-only would silently exclude exactly the orthographies (Cameroonian tone among them) this feature exists to serve.
decisions.rejected: Restricting promotion to pairs with a precomposed NFC form.

SC-007 changes from 'exactly once' to 'at least once / nothing unclassified' because non-exclusivity makes dual reachability intended; the corresponding 'classified twice' assertion in the worklist must be deleted, not worked around.

OPEN PLAN-TIME DECISION: which of three competing key-budget determinations becomes canonical (a numeric prefill parameter with no producer, categorical axis A7, or the offline facet-index classifier). US3/FR-016 depends on it.

Issue #1433 (this station's answer and the diacritic-behaviour axis A4 can silently disagree, with nothing in the strategy decision tree or its self-check table detecting it) is adjacent and NOT closed by this feature. The follow-up regional-prefill spec touches the same seam and should settle it.

Constitution Article VI declares team ownership in the SINGULAR, but this feature is genuinely split: engine owns the answer type, worklist mapping and key budget; content owns the designer-facing wording. Must be confirmed at the plan Constitution Check rather than assumed to pass.

km-strategy judges that deferring issue #1433 makes it MATERIALLY WORSE: this feature triples the S2 answer surface (treatment + promotion + order, independently settable) while leaving it entirely disconnected from strategy selection, so there are more ways for the axis-driven decision tree to recommend a strategy the author's answers contradict. Escalated to the product owner as a scope decision.

Corpus hygiene, not fixed: NINE duplicated spec NNN prefixes (010, 012, 023, 030, 036, 046, 047, 050, 051). The 046 collision already caused a real misattribution during this feature's review. Residual risk is narrow: the relocation must emit byte-identical facet-index values (re-run facet-index and diff docs/keyboard-facet-index.json, expect no change) and base-layouts.json moves out of a deliberately tool-local spec 040 location.

US2 acceptance scenario 4 (Given a touch target, the mark-before-letter option is not offered) is satisfiable only VACUOUSLY - no touch-only target exists in the spine. The plan reads FR-014s second clause as load-bearing and pins it with a touch-derivation test instead. If the product later gains a real target-platform notion, that AC becomes live and needs re-examination.

Engine is at 0.1.0, so the 18 major-version-bump lands as 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 under pre-1.0 semver (the minor is the breaking signal). Intent is satisfied but the literal wording of 18 says major - confirm at the required joint engine+content session rather than assuming.

FR-014 clause 1 (the mark-before-character option MUST NOT be OFFERED for a touch target) is satisfied only vacuously: the spine routes every project through both the desktop and touch steps, so there is no touch-only target to withhold an option from. Only clause 2 (not PRODUCIBLE there) is actually verified. This matches research D5 and was a deliberate plan decision, but it means US2 AC4 has no non-vacuous test and would need revisiting if a touch-only target is ever introduced.

approach: Replace S2's single mutually-exclusive answer with a MarkTreatmentAnswer record (per-mark treatment, an independent promoted-composed-character set, and the input order folded in from the retired S3), reducing the series from five rendered stations to four. Promote the facet-index spare-key measurement into packages/contracts as the single authoritative key-budget determination, with axis A7 redefined as a boundary-preserving projection of it. Close the strategy seam by having the marks series emit computedAxes (an existing additive optional field), so the recorded treatment reaches selectStrategy instead of being invisible to it.
